findings: The book counts DNA length in nucleotides (146 per nucleosome, 80 in linker DNA, 140 million per chromosome); these are base pairs of double-stranded DNA. Linker length varies (often 20-80 base pairs). Kept as printed.
'DNA is a negatively charged' is read as DNA is negatively charged. The Tidbit on heterochromatin and euchromatin is carried.

Figure 19.4 labels the last stage 'Chromatid 1,400 nm' while the book's text gives the chromatid as 700 nm thick; 1,400 nm is the width of a whole duplicated chromosome (two chromatids of about 700 nm). The figure is drawn as printed and the Roman Urdu lesson explains the difference; flagged for the owner.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
